exec: const data = pm.response.json().data; const cells = data.bingo_board_5x5;

pm.test('25 positions and one donation', () => { pm.expect(cells.length).to.eql(25); pm.expect(new Set(cells.map(c => c.position)).size).to.eql(25); pm.expect(cells.filter(c => c.family === 'DONATION').length).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Unique quests and exact budget', () => { pm.expect(new Set(cells.map(c => c.quest_code)).size).to.eql(25); pm.expect(cells.reduce((sum,c) => sum + (c.level || 0),0)).to.eql(data.budget); });

if(pm.response.code===200){ const input=JSON.parse(pm.request.body.raw); const cells=pm.response.json().data.bingo_board_5x5; pm.test('Targets, UTF-8, safe levels and center donation',()=>{ for(const c of cells.filter(c=>c.family!=='DONATION')){ const q=input.quests.find(q=>q.quest_code===c.quest_code); pm.expect(c.target_value).to.eql(q.ladder[c.level-1]); pm.expect(c.level).to.be.at.most(q.safe_level); pm.expect(c.title).not.to.include('?'); pm.expect(c.unit).to.eql(q.unit); } if(input.board.center_quest==='DONATION') pm.expect(cells[12].quest_code).to.eql('DONATION'); }); }
